Unlock your First Home-Bayleys Marlborough
Blenheim, Marlborough Region-Event Brite
name: Unlock your First Home
long_description:
Overview

Get ready to buy your first home with practical tips, expert advice, and a confidence boost—in person!

Join Karen Essex-Mooney and Stephanie Burdis of Loan Market, Blenheim, in conjunction with Bayleys Real Estate, for an informative and engaging event designed to help you take your first steps onto the property ladder.

You will also hear from a local property expert and a risk insurance adviser who will share valuable insights, practical tips, and guidance to help you navigate the home-buying journey with confidence.

Whether you're just starting to explore your options or getting ready to buy, this is a great opportunity to ask questions, gain expert advice, and feel more prepared for your first home purchase.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Open Studio Day-Mish Mash Make
Lower Hutt-Event Brite
name: Open Studio Day
long_description:
Overview

Come check out our art studio to see what we’re all about, contribute to our giant collaborative art piece, and make something of your own!

Open Studio Day


Join us at Mish Mash Make for an exciting Open Studio Day!

This in-person event is the perfect opportunity to explore what we have to offer and connect with fellow creatives.

Date & Time: Drop ins welcome! We're open 10:00am - 3:00pm Saturday 17 October 2026.

We look forward to welcoming you to our studio, come and get inspired at Mish Mash Make!


This is a drop-in event and tickets are not required. We do appreciate a small donation (cash or bank transfer) to help cover the cost of materials, if you are able.
